summary: ImmunityBio filed an 8-K to disclose an exclusive development and supply agreement with Japan BCG Laboratory (JBL) for the Tokyo-172 BCG strain. JBL manufactures and exclusively supplies the product; ImmunityBio handles all U.S. development, trials, and regulatory approvals. The agreement is ten years from FDA approval, with ImmunityBio having a right of first negotiation for ex-U.S. territories. No upfront payment; supply vials for regulatory submission are free. Post-FDA approval, ImmunityBio must purchase at least two batches per year. The arrangement is a standard licensing/supply deal with no equity, tender, or special-situation restructuring involved. Watch for FDA approval timeline and commercial launch execution.
